# agentgateway_llm_settings (Resource)

The singleton `llm` section overlay: which gateways LLM traffic is attached to, or the deprecated port and TLS listener.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach LLM traffic to gateways. This is the recommended shape: it works in
# hybrid storage mode and can be read back from the database.
resource "agentgateway_llm_settings" "default" {
  gateways = ["default", "llm/listener"]
}

# The deprecated alternative binds LLM traffic to a dedicated port with its own
# TLS listener. It conflicts with `gateways`, so use one or the other:
#
# resource "agentgateway_llm_settings" "default" {
#   port = 8080
#
#   tls_json = jsonencode({
#     cert = "/etc/tls/tls.crt"
#     key  = "/etc/tls/tls.key"
#   })
# }
#
# In hybrid mode a field the config file also sets is file-owned: a differing
# write fails with a diagnostic telling you to remove it from the file.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `gateways` (List of String) Gateways to attach LLM traffic to, as `<gateway>` or `<gateway>/<listener>`. Defaults to `default` server-side. A non-empty list conflicts with `port`; an empty list does not.
- `port` (Number) Deprecated upstream. Port the LLM listener binds to. Conflicts with a non-empty `gateways` list; prefer `gateways`.
- `tls_json` (String) Server TLS configuration used with the deprecated `port`, as JSON.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default`; the settings resource is a singleton.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision of the settings overlay.
